problem: A candidate can finish exact-head gates green while another agent moves main, leaving the candidate behind or conflicted at protected merge.
root_cause: Gate authority was bound to candidate head but not also to a current-main integration epoch and short-lived terminal landing ownership.

evidence.observed: green gate lineage later became 10 commits behind main with a real merge conflict and was closed unmerged

prevention: TERMINAL_GREEN_REQUIRES_CURRENT_MAIN_EPOCH: protected merge authority must bind exact candidate head to exact current main.
LANDING_LEASE_SERIALIZES_ONLY_INTEGRATION: parallel development remains allowed; only the final merge boundary is serialized.
BEHIND_BY_ZERO_AT_LANDING: a terminal landing candidate must be reconciled onto current main before protected merge.
MAIN_MOVE_INVALIDATES_LANDING_PROOF: if main changes after gates, reconcile, re-prove exact head and reacquire the landing lease.
DUPLICATE_OBLIGATION_SINGLE_FLIGHT: only one executable terminal candidate may exist per obligation.
MERGE_FAILURE_IS_RECOVERY_INPUT: conflict/CAS refusal automatically returns the lineage to reconciliation instead of ending the task.
